1543401.name: Heavy Particle Cannon
1543401.description: Fires a heavy particle cannon, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1543402.name: Sludge Missile
1543402.description: Fires sludge missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

1543404.name: Homing Laser
1543404.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1543405.name: Saturation Attack II
1543405.description:
Launches an all-out assault on all Nikkes, dealing damage.
Island Eater generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Saturation Attack II. While the barrier is up, only Iron Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1543406.name: Vulcan Cannon
1543406.description: Fires a barrage of Vulcan Cannon shots, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1543407.name: Radial Barrage
1543407.description: Rains down a shower of bullets from above, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes.

1543409.name: Stomp
1543409.description: The Island Eater strikes the ground, sending forth a damaging wave. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals damage to all Nikkes.
